01

PC & laptop repair

From a device that won’t start to a system that keeps crashing—we help find the cause and the right fix.

Startup & stability

No power, black screens, Windows boot failures, blue-screen errors, unexpected restarts, freezing and application crashes. We diagnose whether the issue comes from hardware, drivers or software.

Hardware diagnosis & repair

Motherboard and power-related faults, RAM errors, failing HDDs and SSDs, laptop charging problems, keyboard and display issues, damaged ports, fans and connected components. Replacement recommendations depend on diagnosis and compatibility.

Cooling & preventive servicing

Internal dust cleaning, thermal paste replacement, cooling fan checks and overheating troubleshooting to keep your computer running more reliably.

Performance troubleshooting

Slow startup, high CPU or memory usage, insufficient storage and background software issues. We identify bottlenecks before recommending upgrades.

02

Windows, software & data

Get your computer working properly, with data safety at the centre of the process.

Windows installation & formatting

Fresh installation, reinstallation, PC formatting, boot repair, Windows update troubleshooting and essential driver setup. We discuss your files and backup options before any formatting.

Software & driver support

Installation and configuration of properly licensed software, application errors, driver conflicts, compatibility problems and everyday productivity software setup.

Virus & security support

Malware and unwanted software removal, browser pop-up troubleshooting, antivirus configuration and practical security settings.

Backup, migration & account recovery

File backup and transfer, SSD migration and owner-authorised Windows password reset or account recovery. We prioritise repairs that preserve your data; recovery depends on drive condition, encryption and the problem involved.

03

Custom builds & upgrades

A computer configured around the work you actually do.

Custom PC assembly

Requirement-based component selection and assembly for home, office, gaming, design, video editing and professional workloads. Includes compatibility planning, cable management, setup and stability checks.

SSD, RAM & storage upgrades

Memory expansion, SSD installation, additional storage and data migration where supported. We check your device’s specifications before suggesting components.

CPU, graphics & power upgrades

Compatible processor, graphics card, power supply and cooling upgrades, with attention to power requirements, case clearance and system balance.

Setup & handover

Operating system and driver configuration, peripheral setup and an explanation of the completed work. Parts requirements and work charges are discussed individually.

04

Networking & IT support

Connected offices. Dependable systems. Practical support.

Office LAN & WLAN setup

Wired office networks, wireless network planning, access point setup and Wi-Fi coverage troubleshooting for homes and businesses.

Routers, switches & VLANs

Router and switch configuration, IP addressing, DHCP setup, VLAN segmentation and troubleshooting device-to-device connectivity.

Firewall configuration

Firewall rules and access settings based on your office requirements, network security configuration and troubleshooting authorised connectivity.

On-site & remote IT support

Computer and software troubleshooting at your home or office, remote assistance when suitable, printer/scanner setup, shared printer issues, audio, webcam, Bluetooth and other peripheral support.

05

Website development

Make your business easy to discover and easy to contact.

Business & portfolio websites

Responsive websites that explain your services clearly and guide visitors towards a useful action, such as a call or WhatsApp enquiry.

Redesign & maintenance

Updates to content and layouts, mobile usability improvements, broken page fixes and ongoing website maintenance according to your requirements.

Performance & accessibility

Attention to loading speed, readable content, keyboard navigation, image optimisation and search-friendly page structure.

Launch support

Domain and hosting setup assistance, deployment and basic website handover. The platform and scope are selected around the project.

06

Logo design & video editing

A clear visual identity and content ready for your audience.

Logo design

Business logo concepts and refinements shaped around your brand, audience and the places you plan to use the logo.

Video editing

Editing for business videos, reels and promotional content, including cuts, transitions, captions, audio adjustments and format preparation.

Social media creatives

Branded promotional graphics and social media designs, with dimensions and deliverable formats agreed for the project.

07

SEO & Google Business

Help the right people find your business online.

On-page & technical SEO

Page titles, descriptions, heading structure, internal links and technical checks that help search engines understand your website.

Google Search Console & indexing

Search Console setup, sitemap submission and diagnosis of indexing issues. Indexing decisions and timing are controlled by Google.

Google Business Profile

Business profile creation and setup, help with the verification process, service details, contact information and opening hours, subject to Google’s eligibility requirements.

Local search visibility

Improve the consistency and relevance of your business information for local searches. Search positions and verification outcomes are not guaranteed.

Your data deserves care.

Tell us about important files before repair. We discuss backup options and obtain your approval before formatting or other work that could affect your data. A failing drive or encrypted device may limit what can be recovered.
